12666b08d2daf717.description: OUR PURPOSE AND CULTURE We are driven to create a future where people and place enrich one another. We are wholly committed to rooting ourselves more deeply in every place we are in while setting new benchmarks for positive impact. As a pioneering collective with a common purpose, we curate extraordinary moments and honor the soul of every place along our journey. At Rosewood Hotel Group, we answer The Calling. Together, we Make the Place. THE TEAM At Olea, our Mediterranean Coastal Cuisine restaurant, you will be part of the Culinary team, reporting to the Executive Sous Chef. You will lead a dynamic kitchen operation focused on delivering exceptional dining experiences, innovative menu offerings, and consistently outstanding food quality within a luxury hospitality environment. YOUR ROLE As Chef de Cuisine, you will lead the culinary vision and day-to-day kitchen operations for Olea. You will be responsible for creating memorable dining experiences through innovative menus, exceptional food quality, and strong operational leadership. Working closely with the Executive Chef and Executive Sous Chef, you will oversee food production, team development, cost management, and compliance standards while driving excellence across every aspect of the restaurant’s culinary offering. HOW YOU’LL MAKE THE PLACE Lead all aspects of kitchen operations, ensuring exceptional food quality, consistency, presentation, and guest satisfaction. Create and continuously enhance Mediterranean coastal dining experiences through innovative menus, seasonal promotions, and signature dishes. Develop, coach, and inspire kitchen associates, fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning. Manage staffing, scheduling, inventory, and food cost controls to support operational and commercial success. Partner with culinary leadership to plan menus, manage purchasing requirements, and optimize restaurant performance. Ensure full compliance with food safety, hygiene, health and safety, and company operating standards. COULD THIS BE YOU? You bring substantial culinary leadership experience gained within a luxury hotel, fine dining restaurant, or similarly high-profile hospitality environment. You are passionate about Mediterranean cuisine and creating memorable dining experiences through creativity and attention to detail. You have proven expertise in leading, developing, and motivating high-performing kitchen teams. You possess strong knowledge of HACCP principles, food safety standards, and kitchen operations. You demonstrate sound commercial awareness, including food cost management, labour planning, and inventory control. You hold a culinary qualification and communicate confidently in English, both verbally and in writing. OUR BENEFITS As part of our team, you’ll enjoy a thoughtfully designed benefits package that supports your wellbeing, professional growth, and life beyond work. This includes medical coverage, complimentary room nights, learning and development opportunities, and global career opportunities across Rosewood Hotel Group. Associates are also entitled to benefits and leave provisions in accordance with applicable Saudi Arabian labour laws and company policies. OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU At Rosewood Hotel Group, your voice is heard – and valued. We’re a community that encourages associates to be themselves, not fit into a fixed culture, and this philosophy shines through in our commitments to reflect and honor the history, culture and geography of our destinations. We’re not only committed to building and nurturing genuine, long-lasting relationships but to transforming them – and our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) strategy helps put these principles into practice.

12a7fd9af7febbe1.description: Job Description WSP is seeking an experienced Quantity Surveyor (MEP) to join our team on a major infrastructure construction supervision project in Madinah. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing all MEP quantity surveying activities, including measurement, valuation, cost control, payment certification, and variation assessment across a complex infrastructure environment. Working closely with the Resident Engineer, Construction Supervision Team, Contractors, and Client representatives, the Quantity Surveyor (MEP) will play a key role in ensuring accurate commercial administration and contract compliance throughout the project lifecycle. Responsibilities Key Responsibilities Review and verify MEP-related quantities based on approved drawings and project specifications. Perform quantity take-offs, measurements, remeasurements, and quantity verification for infrastructure works. Evaluate and assess variations, change orders, claims, and additional works in accordance with contract requirements. Review contractors' interim payment applications and provide recommendations for certification. Monitor project costs and ensure compliance with approved budgets and contractual provisions. Verify completed work on site and coordinate with engineering and supervision teams regarding progress and measurements. Review Bills of Quantities (BOQ), specifications, preambles, and contract documents to ensure accurate valuation of works. Prepare cost estimates and quantity reports as required by the project. Maintain records of measurements, payment certificates, variation orders, and cost reports. Assist in the preparation of commercial correspondence and contractual documentation. Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams to resolve commercial and technical issues related to MEP works. Ensure all quantity surveying activities comply with project procedures, contract conditions, and industry best practices. Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Quantity Surveying, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline. Minimum 7–10 years of Quantity Surveying experience in tunnel and infrastructure projects, preferably on major infrastructure projects. Strong multidisciplinary MEP knowledge covering: HVAC Systems Fire Fighting Systems Electrical Systems (HV/MV/LV) ELV Systems Telecommunications SCADA Systems Wet Utilities including Potable Water, Sewerage, Stormwater, and Irrigation Networks. Proven experience in quantity take-off, quantity verification, remeasurement, and assessment of scope changes based on approved drawings. Extensive experience in reviewing and certifying interim payment applications and assessing variations under both Lump Sum and Re-measurable contracts. Sound understanding of BOQ descriptions, Contract Preambles, and CESMM4 measurement principles. Practical hands-on experience in MEP Quantity Surveying and post-contract commercial management activities is essential. Demonstrated ability to evaluate contractor submissions, measurements, payment certificates, variation orders, and claims for infrastructure projects. Proficiency in AutoCAD and advanced Microsoft Excel is mandatory. Strong analytical, reporting, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Previous experience working on construction supervision, PMC, or infrastructure consultancy projects in the Middle East is highly desirable. Membership of a recognized professional body such as RICS or equivalent will be considered an advantage. Essential Requirement: Given the multidisciplinary nature of the project, candidates must possess strong practical experience in MEP quantity surveying, commercial administration, payment certification, variation assessment, and post-contract cost management within large-scale infrastructure and tunnel projects. Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all. Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world. With us, you can. Apply today.

126d24ea6fe48ac1.description: About Mahally: Mahally is Saudi Arabia’s home for local commerce. We bring thousands of Saudi stores — across beauty, fashion, home, food, gifting, electronics, and more — into one marketplace and one app, making it easier for customers to discover and buy from local brands. We’re more than a catalogue. Mahally is a demand engine for Saudi merchants — helping great products get discovered and connecting shoppers with local businesses they may not have found otherwise. About the Role: We’re looking for an SEO Manager to own Mahally’s organic search strategy end-to-end, covering technical SEO, content and organic growth, and AI-driven discovery (GEO/AEO). This is not a keyword-reporting role. Mahally is a large, dynamic marketplace with millions of URLs, constantly changing stores and products, and significant opportunities to improve how search engines crawl, index, understand, and rank our content. You’ll lead the work to strengthen our technical SEO foundation, improve indexation and discoverability, build scalable organic landing-page strategies, and create sustainable organic growth that isn’t dependent on individual merchants or products. You’ll also help shape how Mahally appears across emerging AI and answer engines, including ChatGPT Search, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google’s AI-powered search experiences. Working closely with Engineering, Product, Content, and Merchant teams , you’ll turn SEO opportunities into clear priorities and measurable business impact. Success will be measured not only by rankings and visibility, but by qualified organic traffic, orders, and GMV. What You'll Do 1- Fix the technical foundation Own technical SEO for a marketplace at scale: crawl budget, indexation, canonicalisation, pagination, faceted navigation, internal linking, sitemaps, Core Web Vitals, and JS rendering. Diagnose and resolve index bloat — decide which page types deserve to be indexed at all, and enforce it through robots directives, canonical strategy, and sitemap hygiene. Solve for churn: define what happens to a store or product URL when it disappears, so we stop leaking equity every time a merchant leaves. Partner with Engineering on an SEO backlog that actually ships — with clear specs, acceptance criteria, and measured impact after release. 2- Build organic surfaces that last Design and grow durable page types — category, collection, brand, city, intent, and comparison pages — that don't depend on any single merchant staying. Own the content roadmap for organic: Arabic-first keyword and intent research, briefs, publishing cadence, and refresh cycles. Optimise store and product templates: titles, meta, headings, structured data, on-page copy, and merchandising signals. Build internal linking as a system, not a one-off project. 3- Own AI and answer-engine visibility (GEO/AEO) Define and execute Mahally's strategy for generative and answer engines: crawler access policy, structured data, entity clarity, citable content, and brand presence in AI answers. Make deliberate decisions about which AI crawlers we allow and why — and be able to defend the trade-off between control and visibility. Track and report where Mahally appears in AI answers for commercial Saudi queries, and close the gaps. 4- Measure honestly Own Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs/Semrush, and log-file analysis. Build reporting that ties organic to sessions, orders, and GMV — not just impressions. Set up rank, indexation, and coverage monitoring with alerts, so we catch a drop in days rather than a quarter. Run structured tests on page templates and title/meta patterns and report the causal read where you can get one. 5- Work across the business Brief and influence Engineering, Product, and Content without owning their roadmaps. Guide merchants on the content and imagery that make their pages rank and convert. Present organic performance, risks, and opportunities to leadership with a clear point of view and a clear ask. What Success Looks Like You’ll help Mahally build an organic acquisition engine that scales with the marketplace — improving how efficiently our pages are crawled and indexed, increasing qualified organic discovery, creating durable search surfaces, and strengthening Mahally’s presence across both traditional and AI-powered search. Practical experience implementing, auditing, and optimising structured data/schema markup , particularly for e-commerce, including Product, Offer, Breadcrumb, Organization, or similar schemas. Professional proficiency in both Arabic and English , with the ability to conduct Arabic keyword and search-intent research and assess the quality and relevance of Arabic SEO content. Strong analytical and commercial mindset , with the ability to quantify SEO opportunities, prioritise initiatives based on potential impact, and measure results across organic traffic, conversions, and business outcomes. Proven experience partnering directly with Engineering and Product teams to translate SEO findings into clear technical requirements and successfully deliver SEO improvements at scale. Nice to Have Experience with GEO/AEO and AI-powered search discovery . SQL, Python, or scripting experience for log analysis, bulk SEO audits, or automated monitoring. Experience with multilingual SEO, including hreflang and Arabic/English content strategies. Experience with App Store Optimization (ASO) or web-to-app discovery. Experience working in Saudi Arabia or the GCC , with an understanding of local search and consumer behaviour. Digital PR, authority-building, or regional link-acquisition experience.

1219e77de48a4b85.description: About Halwani Brothers Halwani Brothers is seeking a Refrigeration Technician to join their team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role involves skilled mechanical maintenance duties focused on refrigeration systems and related equipment. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to perform skilled mechanical maintenance, including the inspection, repair, installation, and alteration of refrigeration systems and associated equipment. The technician will also be responsible for executing preventive maintenance and routine servicing to ensure optimal equipment performance. Key Responsibilities Inspect, repair, modify, and install HVAC equipment, including refrigeration and air conditioning compressors, condensers, chillers, water cooling towers, pumps, and various valves. Conduct regular preventive maintenance inspections on refrigeration units, isolated heating and ventilating units, and make necessary adjustments or repairs. Service and repair evaporative coolers. Repair or replace defective parts in units and equipment, including thermostats, automatic switches, fan controls, relays, filters, belts, compressors, and safety valves. Repair and rebuild semi-hermetic reciprocating compressors and compressors for centrifugal refrigeration machines. Perform skilled electrical maintenance work in the repair, installation, and alteration of HVAC equipment, components, and wiring systems; connect motors to control panels. Lubricate and pack heating, ventilation, refrigeration, and air-conditioning motors, pumps, fans, and other equipment. Install and calibrate systems; install copper tubing and repair pipes and tubing as necessary; test joints and insulate pipes of refrigeration and air conditioning systems. 123a9ab05af7862d.description: About Gilead Sciences and Kite Gilead Sciences, Inc. is dedicated to improving global health through the development of therapies for diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19, and cancer. Kite, a biopharmaceutical company within Gilead, specializes in developing innovative cancer immunotherapies, specifically chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) and T cell receptor (TCR) engineered cell therapies. These therapies reengineer a patient’s own immune cells to combat cancer. The company operates in a dynamic and innovative environment, with multiple planned launches and evolving competitive landscapes globally. The Role of Cell Therapy Account Manager The Cell Therapy Account Manager (CTAM) serves as the primary point of contact for Kite’s Authorized Treatment Centers (ATCs) in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time, field-based role involves developing and maintaining relationships with ATCs, ensuring a seamless customer experience, and driving the appropriate utilization of Kite’s CAR T therapies within these accounts. The CTAM will cultivate strong relationships with account stakeholders, coordinate all Kite activities, and communicate the value of CAR T therapy to key decision-makers. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain Kite’s relationship with assigned ATCs, including building account profiles and fostering business relationships with senior leadership, Thought Leaders (TLs), and other key stakeholders. Serve as the primary contact for ATCs, collaborating with cross-functional Kite colleagues (*, Market Access, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Quality) to address stakeholder needs and develop solutions. Manage day-to-day operations within accounts, coordinating activities such as site qualification, site setup, and patient treatment, and ensuring compliance-related activities like periodic audits. Provide clinical instruction to clinical staff, including guidance on AE Management and Product Inserts (PI), and oversee activities in patient treatment areas to ensure Chain of Identity (COI) per SOP protocols. Drive appropriate utilization of Kite’s therapies by assessing performance, developing strategic account plans, and educating key ATC stakeholders on product use, approved messaging, and clinical data in collaboration with Marketing and Medical Affairs. 12429eacb7c4ffed.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المدينه المنوره لنقل الحجاج عن أخصائي تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة أو جدة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تسويق خدمات نقل الحجاج والمعتمرين والزوار، واستقطاب العملاء، وإعداد العروض، ومتابعة العقود والحجوزات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2-5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. الهدف من الوظيفة يركز أخصائي التسويق على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء لتحقيق مستهدفات المبيعات وتعزيز الإيرادات. يشمل ذلك تطوير استراتيجيات تسويقية فعالة لخدمات النقل، وتحليل السوق، وضمان رضا العملاء من خلال عروض تنافسية وخدمة ممتازة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع الأهداف والخطط التسويقية لخدمات نقل الحجاج والمعتمرين. تحليل أسعار المنافسين لتطوير سياسات وباقات تسعير تنافسية. تحديد البرامج الترويجية واختيار أفضل القنوات للتسويق. بناء وتوطيد العلاقات مع شركات ومؤسسات الحج والعمرة ووكالات السفر. وضع جدول زمني لتنفيذ الحملات التسويقية الخاصة بمواسم الحج والعمرة. متابعة أداء الحملات التسويقية لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المستهدفة. تقييم واختبار مسارات وباقات نقل الحجاج والمعتمرين الجديدة قبل طرحها رسمياً، باستخدام البرامج والأنظمة الرقمية المعتمدة. إعداد تقارير الأداء التسويقي والعلاقات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول لتطوير الخدمات الميدانية. حفظ البيانات وفق السياسات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال التسويق، ويفضل أن يكون ذلك في قطاع النقل أو السياحة الدينية. القدرة على تحليل السوق وتحديد الفرص التسويقية. مهارات قوية في بناء العلاقات والتواصل الفعال. القدرة على إعداد العروض التقديمية والتفاوض على العقود. إتقان استخدام البرامج والأنظمة الرقمية ذات الصلة بالتسويق. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مكة المكرمة أو جدة. سيعمل أخصائي التسويق ضمن فريق ديناميكي يهدف إلى تعزيز مكانة الشركة في سوق نقل الحجاج والمعتمرين والزوار. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

Conduct Pre/Post Flight Editing and monitor attendance of all Passenger Handling staff (Check-in, MAAS/PRM). Conduct daily staff briefings, assign and distribute work, review for accuracy, and provide recommendations to the Passenger Services Manager. 12c1273f28d4c489.description: Design the Vision. Deliver the Detail. The most rewarding spaces are the ones you help bring to life, not just the ones you imagine. If you combine a designer’s creativity with the technical precision to see a project through on-site, this opportunity puts both strengths to work. Our client, a growing luxury interior design and construction company in Riyadh, is seeking an Interior Design Engineer to turn client ambitions into thoughtfully designed, carefully executed interiors. A compelling concept is only the beginning. The real achievement is preserving its character through every drawing, material selection, and finishing detail. In this role, you’ll connect creative direction with practical delivery. Working closely with clients, design teams, contractors, and suppliers, you’ll help ensure that finished spaces reflect the approved vision while meeting functional requirements and project timelines. For a hands-on designer, this is an opportunity to stay involved where your decisions matter: from the first client conversation to the final site inspection. About Our Client Our client specialises in luxury interior design and construction execution for corporate and private clients. Based in Riyadh, the company manages projects across the full lifecycle, bringing together concept development, design, project management, and on-site delivery.Its work requires more than visual appeal. Every project calls for an understanding of how a space should look, function, and be built. You’ll contribute to the full process, working where design intent meets materials, craftsmanship, and client expectations. What You’ll Own You’ll take an active role across the design and execution journey, with responsibilities that extend beyond the drawing board. Translate client ambitions into a clear design direction. Develop mood boards, color schemes, and material palettes that balance aesthetic preferences with the practical needs of each space. Create photorealistic visualizations using 3ds Max with V-Ray or Corona to help clients understand and confidently approve the concept. Turn approved concepts into buildable details. Produce accurate Revit and AutoCAD execution drawings, architectural layouts, joinery details, and finishing specifications that give execution teams clear guidance. Bring the right materials into the finished space. Source and evaluate materials, select and approve samples, coordinate with suppliers, negotiate terms, and manage delivery schedules to support project progress. Protect design quality on-site. Conduct regular visits during finishing stages, review work against approved drawings, and collaborate with contractors to resolve discrepancies and practical challenges. Keep clients informed and projects moving. Lead design presentations, explain recommendations clearly, communicate progress, and address design questions as they arise throughout execution. What Makes You Successful You’re a designer who cares as much about how a space is built as how it looks. You can move confidently between creative exploration, technical documentation, and on-site problem-solving without losing sight of the client’s priorities. You hold a bachelor’s degree in Interior Design, Interior Architecture, or Architectural Engineering, supported by proven experience in both concept development and on-site finishing supervision. Your technical capabilities include strong proficiency in 3ds Max, Revit, AutoCAD, and Photoshop, alongside a sound understanding of materials, furniture, fixtures and equipment (FF&E), joinery, and interior construction details. Additional skills in SketchUp, Lumion, or V-Ray are an advantage. You understand the Saudi design, construction, events, and luxury projects market. Just as importantly, you communicate effectively, handle client requirements thoughtfully, and coordinate multiple projects under tight deadlines. Your portfolio should tell the complete project story: initial concepts, 3D renders, execution drawings, and photographs of completed spaces. What’s In It for You This opportunity brings together the creative and technical sides of interior design in one role. You’ll work on luxury interiors, engage directly with clients, and stay connected to the execution of your designs rather than handing them off at the visualisation stage. The breadth of the work offers practical opportunities to deepen your expertise in material selection, supplier coordination, construction detailing, and site supervision while contributing to a growing business in Riyadh. Bring Your Best Work to Life If you’re ready to take your designs from concept to completed space, we’d like to see what you can create and deliver. Apply with your CV and portfolio, showcasing the projects you’ve helped shape from the first idea to the final finish.

123c0c52aaa894bc.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة بان القابضة عن أخصائي إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى دعم الرئيس المباشر في تحديد الأهداف الرئيسية للإدارة أو القسم، وتنفيذ مجموعة من المهام الإدارية المتنوعة، وتقديم الدعم لزملاء العمل، بالإضافة إلى إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مساعدة الرئيس المباشر في وضع الأهداف الرئيسية للإدارة أو القسم، وأداء وتنفيذ مجموعة من المهام الإدارية المختلفة، والعمل على اقتراح وتطبيق الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات التي تساهم في تحقيقها. تقديم الدعم والمساندة لزملاء العمل الأقل خبرة في الفرع أو الإدارة، والتأكد من نقل الخبرات والمعارف اللازمة لتطويرهم وتحسين مستوى أدائهم. تنفيذ مختلف العمليات الإدارية والإجرائية حسب حاجة العمل بهدف تغطية احتياجات الفرع أو الإدارة من تلك العمليات. تنفيذ العمليات والمشروعات والمبادرات المتخصصة، وتوظيف المعارف والخبرات الفنية بهدف ضمان تحقيق أفضل النتائج. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة والمشاركة في عرضها وتوضيحها، والعمل على حفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إداري ذي صلة. القدرة على أداء وتنفيذ مجموعة متنوعة من المهام الإدارية. مهارات جيدة في إعداد الوثائق والتقارير. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق عمل داعم ومحترف في مجموعة بان القابضة. نطاق العمل يتضمن الدور تقديم الدعم الإداري الشامل للإدارة أو القسم، والمساهمة في تحقيق الأهداف التشغيلية من خلال تنفيذ المهام الموكلة بكفاءة وفعالية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في مجموعة بان القابضة.

12985a603b39a444.description: Who Are We❓ We Are Foodics! a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. 1245bfd3c7d22f90.description: We are looking for an E-Commerce & Marketplace Operations Executive to manage the day-to-day operations of our e-commerce store and marketplaces, including Zid, Amazon, Trendyol, and other sales channels . The ideal candidate should be highly organized, hands-on, and capable of coordinating effectively between the warehouse, branches, customer service, marketplaces, and logistics partners. Key Responsibilities E-Commerce & Order Fulfillment Manage and monitor daily orders through the Zid Dashboard . Review and process incoming orders and ensure they are ready for fulfillment. Manage the complete order lifecycle from order receipt to picking, packing, shipping, and delivery. Coordinate Picking, Packing & Order Fulfillment with the warehouse team. Monitor pending and delayed orders and take immediate action to resolve issues. Handle operational issues related to missing items, incorrect orders, cancellations, exchanges, and returns. Ensure orders are processed and shipped within the required turnaround time. Marketplace Operations Manage daily operations across Amazon, Trendyol, and other marketplaces . Process and monitor marketplace orders according to each platform’s requirements and SLA. Ensure order and shipment statuses are updated accurately. Coordinate between E-Commerce, Marketplaces, Warehouse, Branches, Customer Service, and Logistics . Prepare operational reports covering order fulfillment, delays, cancellations, returns, and operational errors. Identify recurring operational issues and implement corrective actions. Recommend process improvements and automation opportunities to increase efficiency and reduce manual work. Familiarity with SKU management, barcodes, inventory synchronization, and stock transfers . Good knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets . Strong organizational, follow-up, and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage a high volume of orders and coordinate across multiple teams. Strong attention to detail and ability to take ownership of daily operations. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) On-Time Fulfillment Rate Order Accuracy Marketplace SLA Compliance Pending & Delayed Orders Order Cancellation Rate Inventory Accuracy Stock Availability Return & Failed Delivery Rate Issue Resolution Time Overall Operational Efficiency
